configuration.description: Optional settings; archive is a separate authorized upload.

errors.invalid_input: Skill rejects input before a billable request.
errors.provider_failure: Nonzero Skill exit; retain valid partial/local results, report uncertain billing, do not automatically retry.
errors.unknown: Environment, privacy decision, credentials or source version is unconfirmed.
errors.unsupported: Operation or combination is not supported by the selected Skill.

limitations: Synchronous speech synthesis; no streamed speech or voice cloning in this contract.
After archival failure retain local media and retry only the archive workflow when authorized.
No MP3, streaming speech or voice cloning.
Host workflow compatibility does not imply device firmware/network/audio integration.
Implementation routing is fixed by the public service; requests must not select a model, provider or voice.

input.description: Text file and a new output destination.

output.description: New local audio destination in the Provider format; never overwrite.

output.description: Skill stdout on successful completion; archival fields appear only when explicitly requested.

authentication.description: Authentication requirement for the optional archived asset.

content_url.description: Provider-authenticated archived asset URL; not a public URL.
